plugins.author: saustin2010
plugins.summary: TB-303 bass line: Open303 with the Devilfish mods, a drive stage and 13 presets.

plugins.name: 6W6
plugins.author: athousanddetails
plugins.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-6W6 TR-606 drum machine: voices fitted against real hardware recordings, with measured-partial hats and cymbal. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: 8W8
plugins.author: athousanddetails
plugins.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-8W8 TR-808 drum machine: 15 of 16 voices circuit-modelled from the service notes. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: 9W9
plugins.author: athousanddetails
plugins.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-9W9 TR-909 drum machine: circuit-modelled kick, snare, toms, rim and clap, with sampled hats, ride and crash (ER-99 derived), as on the original. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Acid
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: TB-303-style acid bassline sequencer: two blendable lines with generate/mutate, driving a synth track over MIDI, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Airwindows Air3
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Air-band EQ that lifts or tames the very top and the low ground of a mix.

plugins.name: Airwindows ButterComp2
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Smooth, buttery bipolar compressor that stays transparent even when pushed.

plugins.name: Airwindows Chamber2
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Chamber reverb with delay, regeneration and thickness controls.

plugins.name: Airwindows ChorusEnsemble
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Lush multi-tap ensemble chorus.

plugins.name: Airwindows Console7Channel
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Console7 channel stage: analog-style console saturation behind a fader.

plugins.name: Airwindows Density2
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Density saturation with a highpass, for thickening and fattening sounds.

plugins.name: Airwindows Galactic
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Huge, dark, shimmering ambient space reverb.

plugins.name: Airwindows Galactic2
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Galactic reverb with drive, sustain and darkening for vast ambient tails.

plugins.name: Airwindows Galactic3
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Galactic reverb with brightness, detune, derez and size controls.

plugins.name: Airwindows GalacticVibe
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: The pitch-wobble vibrato stage of the Galactic reverbs on its own.

plugins.name: Airwindows Infinity2
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Infinite-sustain reverb with filtering, damping and allpass diffusion.

plugins.name: Airwindows kAlienSpaceship
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Enormous sci-fi space reverb from the kCathedral family.

plugins.name: Airwindows kCathedral5
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Cathedral-sized reverb with early reflections and position control.

plugins.name: Airwindows kCosmos
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Vast cosmic reverb with predelay and early reflections.

plugins.name: Airwindows Mackity
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Mackie-style console distortion: drive it with the input trim, tame it with the output pad.

plugins.name: Airwindows MatrixVerb
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Classic algorithmic reverb with filter, damping, modulation and room size.

plugins.name: Airwindows PitchDelay
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Delay with pitch shifting in the feedback path and a resonant filter.

plugins.name: Airwindows TapeDelay2
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Tape-style delay with flutter and a resonant filter in the repeats.

plugins.name: Airwindows ToVinyl4
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Vinyl mastering stage: mid and side highpass, high limiter and groove wear.

plugins.name: Airwindows Verbity2
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Dense, smooth reverb with size, sustain and mulch controls.

plugins.name: Airwindows ZAcidLowpass
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Acid-style overdriven resonant lowpass filter.

plugins.name: Airwindows ZLowpass2
plugins.author: mmiroshnikov
plugins.summary: Smooth lowpass filter with a choice of slopes.

plugins.name: Boris Granular
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Real-time granular insert effect: incoming audio is written to a 10 s buffer and up to 24 overlapping grains replay it with per-grain random size, delay, pitch, direction, volume and pan. Tempo sync to MPC (1/16 to 4/1, dotted and triplet), freeze, feedback, dry/wet, three grain envelopes, 22 presets and a one-page touchscreen skin with two Q-Link sets. DSP from boris-move, a port of Boris Granular Station by Alessandro Gaiba.

plugins.name: Chordsmith
plugins.author: jacob-sabella
plugins.summary: Chord tool: pads, keys or chord buttons play scale, set or custom chords with voicing, strum, arp and harp modes, MIDI out to other tracks and a built-in preview synth.

plugins.name: Clementine-XT
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Ten-voice wavetable synthesizer modelled exactly on the Microwave II/XT with a ten-page touchscreen skin and Q-Links. Needs your own ROM files in its ROMS folder.

plugins.name: Crate Digger
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Dig for records by genre, style, decade, region and country on Discogs, then stream and play them into an MPC track, with its own screen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: CW-78
plugins.author: athousanddetails
plugins.summary: MPC/Force port of athousanddetails' schwung-CW-78 CR-78 drum machine: voices modelled from the 1979 service notes, with the preset rhythms. Touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Dexed (DX7)
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Yamaha DX7-style 6-operator FM synth (Dexed/MSFA engine) as a native instrument, with .syx bank browsing, all 32 algorithm diagrams and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

plugins.name: Dragonfly Early Reflections
plugins.author: gmorb
plugins.summary: Dragonfly Early Reflections as a native insert effect, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Dragonfly Hall
plugins.author: gmorb
plugins.summary: Dragonfly Hall reverb as a native insert effect, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Dragonfly Plate
plugins.author: gmorb
plugins.summary: Dragonfly Plate reverb as a native insert effect, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Dragonfly Room
plugins.author: gmorb
plugins.summary: Dragonfly Room reverb as a native insert effect, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Dub Force Siren
plugins.author: no3z
plugins.summary: Dub siren with tape echo: siren and zap modes, LFO, filter and ping-pong delay on one page mirroring two banks of eight Q-Links.

plugins.name: EffectForce
plugins.author: Devko
plugins.summary: A live looper and an Octatrack-style performance mixer in one insert slot: the looper records the next bars on MPC's grid (or keeps the bar just played) and plays, layers, rolls (1/2 to 1/32), slows, stops or reverses them; a crossfader (learn the Force's own to it) blends two scenes from a library of 64 one-tap effects (filter sweeps, echo throws, washes, rolls, tape stops, gates), whose sweeps and risers move by themselves from the next bar line. Underneath, a ten-module effect rack in any order (drive, filter, EQ, compressor / OTT, chorus, phaser / flanger, tremolo / gate, granular, delay, shimmer reverb) with macros, LFOs and an 8-slot mod matrix; 62 presets and a 14-page touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

plugins.name: Euclidier
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: 8-lane Euclidean MIDI sequencer: live pattern circle and lane rows with a play-head, per-lane and global randomise, a drum-mode switch, and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

plugins.name: Glass Spheres
plugins.author: Padbangers
plugins.summary: A random sampler after Mutable Instruments Marbles: random gates, melodies and deja vu loops that play other tracks over MIDI or analog gear over the MPC X's CV jacks, with envelopes, LFOs and a modulation matrix.

plugins.name: Helm
plugins.author: Lewinator56
plugins.summary: 32-voice polyphonic synthesizer (Helm engine by Matt Tytel) with 2 cross-mod oscillators, sub, noise, multi-mode filter, 3 LFOs, 3 envelopes, 32-step sequencer & arpeggiator, built-in effects and touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

plugins.name: Hera
plugins.author: saustin2010
plugins.summary: Roland Juno-60: jpcima's Hera engine with its 56 presets, the BBD chorus and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

plugins.name: JV-880
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Roland JV-880 sample-based sound engine as a native instrument, with the original reverb and chorus, a Play page with eight macros and a touchscreen skin.

plugins.name: Keyscope
plugins.author: jacob-sabella
plugins.summary: Listens to any track and names its key, chord, bass note and tuning, from the spectrum of the whole mix; the audio passes through untouched.

plugins.name: Liminal Hz
plugins.author: gmorb
plugins.summary: Real rooms, halls and echoes from impulse responses (up to 5 s, mono or stereo), the space for your NAM amp; ~3.5% of an audio block on a Force; browses reverbs/ folders and TONE3000.

plugins.name: Lucky Dip
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: A random 16-pad drum-kit builder and inspiration machine: dips into your sample library, fills the pads at random, plays the kit and exports it as an MPC drum program.

plugins.name: Machinemodule
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: The Elektron Machinedrum SPS-1 UW sound engine as a native instrument: all 16 tracks from one plugin instance, with its own touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Maze Sequencer
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Dual 8-step generative sequencer (Moog Labyrinth style) with corrupt, scale quantising, two LFOs and per-line MIDI channels, driving other tracks over MIDI.

plugins.name: Maze Voice
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Monophonic Moog Labyrinth-style thru-zero oscillator, wavefolder and state-variable filter voice with two LFOs, a page randomiser and a three-page touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

plugins.name: MeowSynth
plugins.author: mcardonaserrano
plugins.summary: knobster's MeowSynth rebuilt natively from the original's SynthEdit patch: a ramp oscillator through an envelope-following resonant filter that meows, five cats, vibrato and chorus, with the original's look and a meowing cat on the touchscreen and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Monomodule One + FX
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's synth engine (15 machines) as an instrument, plus its 7 effect machines as an audio effect, each with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Morpho-PE
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Four-voice synthesizer modelled on the Poly Evolver's voice: analog-style and digital waveshape oscillators, 2/4-pole lowpass, delay, feedback, distortion, 4 x 16 step sequencer, a bank browser and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links. Loads Poly Evolver program dumps and, from your own Prophet VS ROM chip images, the 95 factory waves.

plugins.name: MPC Commander
plugins.author: jacob-sabella
plugins.summary: The plugins MPC loads, with their own skins, and MPC's transport, on a desktop app. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

plugins.name: MPC Plaits
plugins.author: poloq
plugins.summary: Mutable Instruments Plaits, all 24 models, with LFOs, envelopes, two mod matrices, tempo sync and a touchscreen skin.

plugins.name: MPC Remote
plugins.author: jacob-sabella
plugins.summary: The MPC screen in a browser, and an MCP server so an AI model can see and touch it, play MIDI and read files. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

plugins.name: MPC USB audio
plugins.author: jacob-sabella
plugins.summary: The MPC as a USB audio interface: its outputs and inputs as channels on the computer, next to its MIDI ports.

plugins.name: Mutable Vibe MPC
plugins.author: nachtaktiv303
plugins.summary: Mutable Instruments Rings + Plaits in one synth: 6 resonator models and 14 melodic macro-oscillator engines, with filter, FX, 4 envelopes, 4 LFOs, a mod matrix and tempo sync, plus a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: NAM
plugins.author: jacob-sabella
plugins.summary: Neural Amp Modeler captures as an insert effect, with cab IR, tone, gate, pitch, delay, reverb and an on-device TONE3000 downloader.

plugins.name: Omni Sampler
plugins.author: MrHighMan
plugins.summary: Multi-format sampler: plays Akai, E-mu, Roland, Kontakt/Maschine, SF2 and SFZ instruments straight from their files or sampler disk images, with layers, keyswitching, a mod matrix and its own screen skin.

plugins.name: OTTmpc
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Vital's OTT multiband up/down compressor as an insert effect: live band meters with dB numbers, 12 Q-Link controls and 10 presets.

plugins.name: Overcast
plugins.author: Padbangers
plugins.summary: Mutable Instruments Clouds (Parasites firmware, six modes) with a modulation page: two envelopes, two LFOs and an 8-slot matrix onto Clouds' CV inputs.

plugins.name: Plugin Manager
plugins.author: poloq
plugins.summary: Install, update and remove catalog plugins from the MPC screen, with one MPC restart per batch.

plugins.name: PolyForce
plugins.author: Devko
plugins.summary: Eight-voice wavetable synth: two wavetable oscillators with 8x unison and subs, 30 built-in tables plus your own Serum-format WAVs, two filters with comb and vowel, two LFOs, a 12-slot mod matrix, arpeggiator and sequencers, 205 presets and a seven-tab touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

plugins.name: Profit-08
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Eight-voice, two-layer analog-style synthesizer: stack and split layers, a gated sequencer and arpeggiator, a resonant 2/4-pole filter and a banks browser for your own program and bank SysEx dumps.

plugins.name: RMXXXL
plugins.author: L'Cronx
plugins.summary: RMX-1000-style remix effect: isolator, DJ filter, Build Up / Break Down scenes, synced echo, release FX, Clouds, Dragonfly reverbs, sample pads with ADSR and a brickwall limiter, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

plugins.name: Stream
plugins.author: johnny
plugins.summary: Multichannel USB audio effect send from an MPC to a Mac. Needs BlackHole 64ch and a Mac helper app.

plugins.name: SubForce
plugins.author: Devko
plugins.summary: Analog-style monosynth in the spirit of a 37-key American paraphonic classic: two morphing oscillators with hard sync, a sub and white-to-pink noise, a mixer with its own feedback loop, a 4-pole transistor ladder (6 to 24 dB) with Multidrive, two looping DAHDSR envelopes, two mod busses, glide and Duo, 57 presets (many for melodic techno) and a six-tab touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

plugins.name: TR-MPC
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: A modular 16-slot drum kit: each slot plays any of the 49 voices of athousanddetails' 6W6, 8W8, CW-78 and 9W9 (a 606 kick beside an 808 snare and 909 hats), with per-slot level, tune, decay, drive, pan and sends, one shared reverb, delay and master chain, a randomise module, and a touchscreen skin that reskins each slot to its voice's kit.

plugins.name: TR-MPC Tap FX
plugins.author: sd88me
plugins.summary: Companion to TR-MPC: sends any slot, or the kit's reverb or delay send, out on its own MPC track, sample-aligned with the kit, so MPC's mixer, submixes and insert effects can process it. Needs TR-MPC in the same project.

plugins.name: Vibe FX
plugins.author: nachtaktiv303
plugins.summary: Drive, chorus, FDN reverb and tape delay in one native MPC OS insert effect, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.
